newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Ann Joo debuts at 5.10 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Ann Joo debuts at 5.10 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian steel maker Ann Joo Resources Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday at 5.10 ringgit against an offer price of 2.00 ringgit.
At 0135 GMT the stock was trading at 5.00 ringgit.
Ann Joo's public offer consisted of 20.23 million new shares at 2.00 ringgit each. The company is listed on the exchange's Main Board.
Ann Joo's subsidiaries are inolved in the manufacturing and trading of steel products, which are used in the automotive, electronics and construction industries.

The company earlier this month said it intends to become an integrated steel maker within the next five years. This would entail the manufacture of its own steel billets, which are currently bought from other steel makers in the country.
